mentions.name: Resubird
mentions.description: A free AI-powered resume analyzer that provides ATS insights, a job-match score, and quality suggestions for improving resumes. Planned upcoming features include a resume builder, mock interviews, and cover letter generation.
mentions.problem: The builders were exhausted trying to analyze their own resume and couldn't find any good resume analysis tools without a paywall.
mentions.source_excerpt:
